lessons.title: Why are students protesting in France? | BBC Learning English from the News
lessons.desc:
School pupils in France have been taking part in protests against the government. Pupils say that they are protesting because their schools are not being well funded. Since protests began, over 6,000 people have been arrested and a number of students and police officers have been hurt.
🔎 For a free worksheet, and all the vocabulary and definitions: https://bbc.in/4y9UOwD and for more episodes of Learning English from the News: https://bit.ly/4hUwfPh

lessons.title: I enjoy flying ✈ but airports are stressful 🛄 | Improve your listening with Real Easy English
lessons.desc:
Becca and Neil have a real conversation in easy English about airports – the place we go when we travel by plane. ✈️ 🛄 👩‍✈️
Learn vocabulary like check in, boarding pass, security, boarding gate, and find out whether Becca or Neil has ever missed a flight...! 🏃

lessons.title: What can science tell us about the pain of a broken heart? 6 Minute English
lessons.desc:
6 Minute English now comes with a video🤩 ! It's the same programme that you know and love 💖, but now you can see us! 👀 Let us know what you think in the comments.
Anyone who has had their heart broken will know how horrible it feels. But did you know that the pain you feel is not just imaginary – it registers in the same part of the brain that processes physical pain. So, why do we feel this pain? And if it feels so bad, what is the point of being in love in the first place? Neil and Georgie discuss this and teach you some new vocabulary.

lessons.title: Mental distress is a real issue, says new review | BBC Learning English from the News
lessons.desc:
An independent review into mental health has found a rise in mental distress among children and young people, with anxiety, depression, self-harm and eating disorders among the most common issues. Learn more about this story with Georgie and Neil.
🔎 For a free worksheet, and all the vocabulary and definitions: https://bbc.in/4d2xQjn and for more episodes of Learning English from the News: https://bit.ly/4hUwfPh
